verdict.rationale: Aider's own `/ask` mode and `AI?` watch-mode comments return AI-generated answers and insights about the user's codebase without editing files. Community users confirm it helps them understand unfamiliar codebases. The 'data' covered is source code only, and insights come only on demand in response to the user's questions. missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insights and suggestions, insights over non-code data, documented depth of analysis or reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: /ask Ask questions about the code base without editing any files.
AI? triggers aider to answer your question.
I've used aider to understand new codebases using technologies I don't know and it did a fantastic job
Aider can answer questions I can't search for via LSP, like 'what code would process the following URL' and similar.
